| **Provenance** | Iter-7 (Han): LoRA fine-tuning workload demonstrating PEFT. Random-init backbone (random training data) — measures the SYSTEMS cost of LoRA, not task accuracy. Base parameters genuinely frozen (smoke verifies base_grad_norm == 0). |

## How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
mlperf fetch --workload nano-lora-finetune --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
mlperf run --workload nano-lora-finetune --profile max --open-report

# quick smoke pass
mlperf run --workload nano-lora-finetune --profile min

# research envelope
mlperf run --workload nano-lora-finetune --profile pro
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.
